# Vettore 0.3.7 - Atomic upserts and metadata-filtered search

- Add atomic `Vettore.upsert/2` for ETS collections and exact-match metadata
  filters for Flat and HNSW search.
- Associate scores with record revisions so concurrent writes cannot pair a
  score with newer metadata. Existing snapshots remain readable.
- Reduce copying in quantized search by retrieving full records only for
  reranking the selected candidates.
- Stabilize GPU L2 and L2Squared across extreme coordinate ranges, release
  Flat allocations on close, and validate adaptive search limits early.
